summary: D.C. statehood advocates are marking the anniversary of National Guard deployment to the District while intensifying advocacy efforts ahead of the midterm elections, including carrying the statehood message to other states and securing commitments from federal lawmakers. The deployment, which lasted a year, is being highlighted by advocacy groups as evidence for why D.C. needs greater autonomy. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
